# LeanFoundry

> Ash Maurya's systematic platform for startup founders to validate ideas, build business models, and achieve product-market fit using lean methodology.

LeanFoundry provides comprehensive founder training through playbooks, courses, and tools based on the Lean Canvas framework and Running Lean methodology. The platform has trained 25,000+ founders in demand validation and serves 21,000+ subscribers through its LEAN 1-2-3 newsletter.

## Key Topics

- Lean Canvas
- Ash Maurya
- Product-Market Fit
- Business Model Design
- Demand Validation
- Value Delivery
- Lean Startup Methodology
- Continuous Innovation

- Founder Education
- Traction Roadmap
- MVP Development
- Bootstrapping
- Customer Forces
- Lean Methodology

## Core Training Programs

- [Business Model Design Challenge](https://www.leanfoundry.com/bmd/challenge): 30-day course to stress-test startup ideas with Lean Canvas.
- [Demand Validation Playbook](https://www.leanfoundry.com/dvp/playbook): Demo-Sell-Build framework for 25,000+ founders to prove customer demand in 90 days.
- [Value Delivery Playbook](https://www.leanfoundry.com/vdp/playbook): 10X Launch strategy for MVP development and scaling into happy customers.
- [Fast-Track Bundle](https://www.leanfoundry.com/fast-track): Complete founder training with all 3 playbooks plus LEANSpark AI Co-founder tool.

## Founder Resources & Learning

- [Just Start - Free 10-Day Startup Course](https://www.leanfoundry.com/juststart): Free email course to find startup ideas, build business models, and bootstrap.
- [Running Lean Book](https://www.leanfoundry.com/books/running-lean): International bestseller on lean startup methodology and iterating from Plan A to a working plan.
- [Articles](https://www.leanfoundry.com/articles): Lean startup methodology, business modeling, and validation articles by Ash Maurya.
- [LEAN 1-2-3 Newsletter](https://www.leanfoundry.com/newsletter): Battle-tested startup tips from Ash Maurya to 21,000+ founders.

## Tools & Frameworks

- [Traction Roadmap](https://www.leanfoundry.com/tools/traction-roadmap): Replace fictional financial forecasts with actionable metrics for startup traction.
